name: agent
description: Student agent that connects to the exam-live WebSocket gateway, joins an exam session, and creates the declared submission files on this machine. The Electron app in electron/ is replacing src/cli.ts (design spec 2026-09-01-student-agent-electron-design.md) — cli.ts stays until parity is confirmed (§8.4), then is deleted.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p electron/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p electron/renderer/tsconfig.json
